items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday; not IR, week-to-week after elbow imaging/specialists.
items.why: Dislocated elbow (non-throwing); no surgery/IR lean, aiming return ASAP.
items.implication: Mariota starts; McLaurin value not fully tanked but tough SEA matchup.
items.opportunity: McLaurin 25% share/11+ YPT with Mariota historically.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins for Sunday at Indianapolis due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring; official Friday ruling corroborated by Rapoport.
items.implication: Schultz and other Texans pass-catchers elevated targets/share.
items.opportunity: Schultz saw 30% routes targeted and 28% share last week sans Collins; Colts allow 4th-most TE yards.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) will not practice, listed doubtful vs Broncos; McVay believes return next week vs Eagles barring setback.
items.why: Hip/groin; no great progress, no practice all week; not hernia but caution.
items.implication: Adams WR1 treatment; high target share expected again.
items.opportunity: Adams 42% target rate (60/142 routes) without Nacua as Ram; 8-195-2 last game sans him.

items.text: Broncos RB Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle) SNF vs Rams; JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report, good to go.
items.implication: Dobbins/Harvey committee; reverse prior Coleman beneficiary.
items.opportunity: Both healthy for volume split; Coleman had 83% snaps last when Dobbins left.
items.conflict: Berry still prefers Coleman ROS long-term.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren leads; expect zillion checkdowns as vertical game not working for Rodgers. Homer/Heidenreich backups.
items.why: RB coach: Warren lead, breathers as needed. Vertical pass failing.
items.implication: Warren every-week starter upside in pass game.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + checkdowns; high opportunity with Dowdle absent.

items.text: Packers first game without Jayden Reed: Christian Watson 45 routes, Matthew Golden 44 on 55 Love dropbacks. Watson+Golden 48% targets so far.
items.why: Reed neck/back out; high route shares immediately.
items.implication: Watson/Golden every-week WR2/flex with elevated volume.
items.opportunity: Nearly full route participation + combined half targets.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (core muscle surgery); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.
items.why: Core muscle; at least 6 weeks; Etienne also IR.
items.implication: Hubbard locked top-20 RB option with clear volume.
items.opportunity: Hubbard 50% routes, 5 targets through 2; CAR high PROE/pace up vs CLE.

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% routes this season, 6 targets (8% share) through 3 games. TPRR 33% with London off, 17% on.
items.implication: Fade Pitts unless London out; long-term low opportunity.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.opportunity: Feed the King; high carries expected.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches +15% tgt share both games; RB7 util (86); PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
items.why: Consistent high volume/util + soft run D.

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit tgts both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.why: Volume + deep threat vs soft secondary.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX allows only 55 rush yds/g, 3.2 YPC to RBs. Henderson 65% snaps after.
items.why: Fumble fallout + tough matchup; gap narrowed but Stevenson still ranked ahead.
items.implication: Sit/fade; Henderson rising but not full takeover yet (pass pro concerns).
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead of Henderson W3.
